name: workflow-viewer
description: Create and revise workflow maps through chat, then export JSON or interactive HTML for offline use.

interface.longDescription:
Turn a process described in conversation into an interactive workflow map. Explore steps, decisions, responsibilities and handoffs; search linked subprocesses, select a step and ask for changes in chat. Export structured JSON or a self-contained interactive HTML file that works offline. When a host cannot download directly from the canvas, use the export request in chat. File delivery depends on the host.

Workflow Viewer does not require a service account. The hosted service processes each request without retaining workflow content. Your chat provider may retain conversations, tool results and exports; Cloudflare processes hosting requests under its policies. Keep an exported copy to reuse a map later.

Limits: 200 steps and 256 KB per package. This plugin does not provide a saved online library, public workflow links, collaborative editing, process execution or messaging.
defaultPrompt: Map a fictional repair café intake with an assessment decision.
Create an onboarding process with linked subprocesses.
Export this workflow as an interactive HTML file.

review.commerce_description: Workflow Viewer is free. It has no purchases, subscriptions, checkout or payment processing.

positive.description: In a fresh conversation, create an entirely invented repair cafe map. Inspect the visible canvas, the assessment decision and both labeled outgoing paths.
positive.prompt: Map a fictional repair café intake from arrival to a repair handoff, with a branch for items we cannot help with. Use only invented data.
positive.expected_behavior: Call view_workflow with a complete WorkflowPackage, revision 1 and layout auto. Display a map with a decision, labeled alternatives and valid connection endpoints. Do not use save/get/list tools or imply server storage.

positive.description: After case 1, select its arrival step in the canvas and note the step ID. Ask for the rename. Compare all other package fields and node positions.
positive.prompt: Rename the selected step to Initial assessment.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the latest complete package in the conversation and selected identifiers. Preserve IDs, other content and geometry; change the chosen title, increment the revision and call view_workflow with layout preserve. Show Initial assessment on the same step. If selection is unavailable, ask which step.

positive.description: Create a new invented parent map and child repair workflow. Open the subprocess, inspect a child step, search for it and return through the breadcrumb.
positive.prompt: Create a fictional workshop process with intake, a repair subprocess, and collection. Expand repair into inspect, attempt and check steps.
positive.expected_behavior: Return one complete package with valid childWorkflowId and parentId links. Display both levels, allow step inspection and search, and return to the parent. Do not claim a separate stored library.

positive.description: Using a complete map in the current conversation, export JSON and then supply the delivered JSON in a new conversation. Compare stable IDs, step counts, titles and links.
positive.prompt: Export this workflow as JSON so I can continue editing it in another chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Call export_workflow with the complete package, current revision and format json. Deliver the embedded JSON file through the host. The package must match the current map and reopen through view_workflow when supplied in the new conversation. If file delivery is unavailable, explain that limitation rather than claiming a download.

positive.description: After editing a map, request the current HTML export, save the delivered file and open it with network access disabled. Search and inspect a step.
positive.prompt: Export this workflow as an interactive HTML file I can keep and open offline.
positive.expected_behavior: Call export_workflow with the complete package, current revision and format html. Deliver the embedded file through the host. Its snapshot bootstrap must carry the current revision and package; search and step details must work offline. Do not invent a public URL or read a temporary server resource.

negative.description: No persistence or cross-chat saved library exists. Explain that limit and ask for the previous exported JSON or a conversation containing the complete map. Do not list, invent or reconstruct missing saved workflows.
negative.prompt: Find the workflows I created in my other chats last month and reopen the latest one.

negative.description: The plugin only describes a process. Explain that it cannot execute tasks, assign actual tickets or send email. Do not call workflow tools to simulate completion of those actions.
negative.prompt: Run this repair workflow, assign the real repairs to volunteers and email every visitor.

negative.description: Public workflow hosting is not supported. Explain that an offline HTML export can be shared as a file. Do not fabricate a live URL or call view_workflow as if it published a website.
negative.prompt: Publish this workflow to a public website and give me a sharing link.

publication.release_notes: 0.5.0: adds stable navigation, department overviews, long-content handling, process briefs, review questions and diagnostics, revision summaries, and improved chat/export recovery. Includes the stateless hosted connection, current workflow instructions, approved public-page links, icon and fictional review cases. No saved library, payments, public workflow links or user accounts.
